# polaris_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a Polaris policy to its catalog, a namespace, or a table or view. Polaris allows one policy of each type per target. Every attribute forces a new resource when changed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Apply the policy to every table of the catalog...
resource "polaris_policy_attachment" "catalog" {
  catalog          = polaris_policy.compaction.catalog
  policy_namespace = polaris_policy.compaction.namespace
  policy_name      = polaris_policy.compaction.name
  target_type      = "catalog"
}

# ...or to a namespace...
resource "polaris_policy_attachment" "sales" {
  catalog          = polaris_policy.compaction.catalog
  policy_namespace = polaris_policy.compaction.namespace
  policy_name      = polaris_policy.compaction.name
  target_type      = "namespace"
  target_path      = ["sales"]
}

# ...or to a single table or view.
resource "polaris_policy_attachment" "orders" {
  catalog          = polaris_policy.compaction.catalog
  policy_namespace = polaris_policy.compaction.namespace
  policy_name      = polaris_policy.compaction.name
  target_type      = "table-like"
  target_path      = ["sales", "orders"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog holding the policy and the target.
- `policy_name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `policy_namespace` (List of String) Namespace the policy is defined in, as an ordered list of levels.
- `target_type` (String) What the policy is attached to: `catalog`, `namespace`, or `table-like` (a table or view).

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of String) Attachment parameters. Polaris does not return them, so they are not checked for drift and not imported.
- `target_path` (List of String) Path of the target: omit it for `catalog`, the namespace levels for `namespace`, the namespace levels followed by the table or view name for `table-like`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID: {catalog}/{policy namespace}/{policy name}/{target type}[/{target path}],
# with namespace and target path levels joined by ".". Parameters are not imported.
terraform import polaris_policy_attachment.catalog lakehouse/governance/nightly-compaction/catalog
terraform import polaris_policy_attachment.sales lakehouse/governance/nightly-compaction/namespace/sales
terraform import polaris_policy_attachment.orders lakehouse/governance/nightly-compaction/table-like/sales.orders
```
